text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp was progressing 
smoothly according to the training menu 
prepared by Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aahhhhh... So hot... Dammit all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Except for the fact that Air Shakur's 
tone has gotten even worse.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Forget it. I'm taking a break first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned to Air Shakur with drinks 
ready, she was checking race footage.
choice_data_list:
Is that the race from Britain the other 
day?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Mmm-...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur seemed to be analyzing 
seriously. Looking at her, I suddenly 
pictured her running there.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Curious?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, I shall show you. I have just 
gathered all the necessary data."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna simulate... just how well I'd 
hold up in top-level overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Shakur pressed the enter key, a 
bird's-eye view of the course appeared on 
screen. Near the starting gates, seven 
inverted triangle markers lined up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—The blue one's me. Keep your eyes glued 
on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Post time arrives, and the pieces surge 
forward. On the final straight, Air 
Shakur, who was dead last, makes her move 
from the far outside, but..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, no reach at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume No. 5, who made her move at the 
same time, effortlessly crossed the finish 
line. Air Shakur finished in 5th place."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, 'bout what I expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The elevation change at this racecourse is 
harsher than Nakayama, making for a race 
that demands serious toughness. If we 
squeeze it into her current rotation, this 
is what we'll be dealing with.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, having such a terrible 
matchup was huge too. They're on 
completely different levels in both 
experience and ability.
choice_data_list: The world is so vast, huh.
The world is so vast, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —That's right!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The world is vast. Far, far too vast!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Seeking the Pearl. A 
world-wise Umamusume who ventured overseas 
to take on GⅠ races and seized a brilliant 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine, Shakur. If you want to 
call me Big Sis Pearl, that is?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, call me! Say it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Say what?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As shy as ever, aren't you? No, more like 
a cool, shy beauty.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
By the way, it seems you all want to learn 
about the world.
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I was talking about—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If it is I, I can answer your questions.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And all before breakfast, too! Gourmet 
foods, tourist spots, legends from across 
the globe... My head is a wisdom bag!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to know? Ask anything, 
you're always welcome! Now, ça va!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it sounds like Seeking the Pearl 
has some interesting stories to tell. 
Above all, to return the kindness of her 
reaching out...
choice_data_list:
I want to learn about food from around the 
world!

I want to learn the tricks to traveling 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, just as I thought. You... you really 
get it, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For girls who have strictly routinized 
their everyday meals, dining overseas is 
truly a headache...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, keep up! Shakur, this way!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—When in Rome, do as the Romans do. So, 
what I'd like to introduce is ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, what part of this is "world cuisine"?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... For a girl like you, to not have 
noticed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ice cream! Is deee-licious to eat in the 
summer!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Local cuisine is adapted to the local 
climate. You could say eating it builds a 
body capable of adapting to the 
environment."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"When in Rome, do as the Romans do... Eat 
what suits the environment. It's a world 
menu!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You can't convince me with that. You're 
stretching the interpretation way too far.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Shakur, take a bite and you'll 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, say 'ahh'!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I said I don't need it! You're seriously 
annoying!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like a younger brother being fussed over 
by his older sister... I got to see a 
whole new side of Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeees, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Well then, let's take a walk 
out into the world and see!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Because the means to do so 
are right in front of us!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Shakur... Inside your PC, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Here we go, Enter the 
World!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Shakur pressed the enter key, a 
world map appeared. As if leisurely 
striding across it—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The secret to navigating the world... In 
a single word, it's—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's guts!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! Guts!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Guts! Guuuuts!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut the hell up!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah! An illusion...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Quit spoutin' all that gibberish.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you're talking about tips, give me 
something practical, like choosing 
outbound/inbound routes, track quirks, 
rotations...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Guts actually has plenty of practical 
value, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What you're saying is that preparing to 
take on the world takes time... and that 
we need to look at it from a long-term 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Then the first thing to prepare is the 
grit to keep things going as planned, and 
the grit to handle the unexpected when 
you're there."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Should I really traverse the world in the 
first place? Where is the world I seek...? 
First, I must muster the guts to think it 
through.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur, if you ever feel like taking on 
the world... don't hesitate to rely on Big 
Sis Pearl!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No way.
